ul.li: basic idea: image eiditing and compositing web app
app name is "Compio" (as in "Comp I/O"), package name "compio"
inspired by the UX pioneered by apps like photoshop or affinity photo
create (only if not present, otherwise use existing) turborepo named "compio" with readme.md and package.json, with one app "compio" and libs, packages according to the following instructions
always written in TypeScript, with focus on clean architecture and modular design. Using ts-node is ok.
if not present, add and configure eslint, prettier, dependency cruise and husky, with pre-commit hooks for linting and formatting
in first instance: no backend, composition data is stored as JSON and can be up- and downloaded in client
consider the main modules like renderer, tools, effects, export, etc. as busines domains in the DDD sense, interfaces for these modules must be solution agnostic
client side rendering only, deployable to nginx, apache or as electron app
Stack: TypeScript, React, Vite, TailwindCSS, Radix UI, i18n, Turborepo, ESLint, Prettier, Husky
UI components should be as abstract as possible, allowing easy replacement or modification, and live in turborepo lib
first instance: use React for UI but the mid term goal are web components. Removing React or libs like Radix etc. must not break the high level architecture.
Follow the bulletproof React architecture principles
keep comments concise and relevant, trimmed to the necessary information, do not write prose
do not use "magic" numbers or strings, define them as constants or enums
The UI supports multi language based on i18n with default English. First instance: English only
Plugin architecture for tools, effects etc, with built-in core sets
Plugins register with the core app at startup.

Plugin API includes (not limited to, and unified):
category names like tools, effects, filters, export formats, etc.
name
input type (e.g. image data, parameters, etc.)
output type (e.g. image data, parameters, etc.) - UI components similar to scheme
composition data includes all information about the canvas, layers, and applied tools and effects, and can be exported as JSON file
Plugin Architecture (but JSON based): name="Brightness/Contrast" category="effects" inputType="InputTypesEnum.IMAGE_DATA" outputType="OutputTypesEnum.IMAGE_DATA"
{component.trigger.title}
{children}
comprised of a canvas plus an array of layers

Layer data includes:
image data (raster)
transform data (position, scale, rotation), effects (filters)
blend mode
opacity
layer coordinates are relative to the canvas, with the top-left corner as the origin
Layers have a z-index for ordering
One or several layers can be selected at a time. Composition data includes the currently selected layer(s).
Layers can be grouped, with group transforms affecting all child layers
transforms are applied using a matrix, optionally destructive or non-destructive
Canvas size is defined by the user and can be changed, with all layers being transformed accordingly. Can also be based on a newly loaded image.
Image size (output) is defined by the user and can be changed, with all layers being transformed accordingly. Can also be based on a newly loaded image.
Rendered canvas can be exported as image file (e.g. PNG, JPEG) or as layered file (e.g. PSD, TIFF)

Layers are virtual and get rendered into fthe canvas on changes. Throttle mouse/pointer events during interactions and consider further performance optimizations. Apply only what will make a notable business, whith little 3rd party libs as justifiable, and comment rationale.

module.name: tools
module.concept: - all tools follow a plugin archtecture for extensibility and clean separation - all tools register with the core app at startup - all tools output grayscale image data (single channel) to define the area of effect

transform.concept: - transform tools modify the position, scale, and rotation of layers - transform tools can be applied to individual layers or groups of layers - transform tools support various input methods like mouse, touch, and stylus - transform tools provide visual feedback for the current transformation state - transforms can be applied to selections - active i/o functionality is set by cursor position relative to a bounding box for layer or selection, following established ux for move, scale, rotate, etc., cursor provides feedback by icon
transform.tool: - allows users to resize layers by scaling them up or down
- allows users to rotate layers around a pivot point

selection.concept: - selection tools generate a mask that defines the area of effect for painting tools - multiple selection tools can be used in combination to create complex masks - selections can be modified using various operations like add, subtract, and intersect - selections can be applied as layer masks, to restrict paint and effect operations, and copy/paste/delete operations - effects and painting tools use the generated mask to apply changes only to the selected area - selections can be saved and loaded as channels
selection.tool: - allows users to create a selection mask using various shapes
- allows users to draw freeform selection masks
- allows users to create a selection mask using straight-edged segments
- allows users to create a selection mask based on color similarity

painting.concept: - use a brush tip to define affected area, generated mask defining the strength of the effect - brush tip follows cursor, visual feedback for size and shape - painting tools support various brush properties like size, hardness, opacity, and flow - painting tools support pressure sensitivity for touch and stylus input
painting.tool: - applies paint to the layer based on the generated mask and color/texture settings
- allows users to sample pixels from one area of the image and paint them onto another area

text.concept: - text tools support various font properties like size, weight, style, and alignment - supports graphic properties like color, stroke, shadow, and gradient - text layers can be transformed, styled, and formatted like other layers - text layers can be rasterized
text.tool: - allows users to create and edit text layers - provides a font selection menu
